items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Chani was there first on the boat? ... [INTERVIEWER] And then who took Chani's place? Will's took his place?

ctx.x: And a drummer then would be, uh, well Wills was playing a drummer on a boat with me. with me. Yeah, Will's came on a boat. So, let's see if I got that straight or not.

Chani was there first on the boat? Yeah. And then who took Chani's place? Will's took his place? Yeah, Will's took his place. What's Will's full name? I don't know Will's full name. And this Reuben Oliver, what were you saying about him? Reuben Oliver, does he live near here or something? No, does he know what he's talking about?

Oh, that's uh, Rice Blair between Onzag and La Perouse. We'll have to look for him too. He's out of the... He waits for a sudden demolition. He's out of the trouble. He don't come here. Yeah, but he probably have some good memories. Oh, yeah. How old are you? How old are you? I'm eight, huh? I'm old at nine. I'm going to be married. What? You think he's older than you, Dick? Yeah, he's older than 50. I'm 55. Oh, yeah. He's older than 55. I'm close now. Over 50. I'm 55. I'm 56. I guess.
